tasks.short: Scan labels and confirm the receipt.

steps.what: List labels missing from the stored receipt
Scan labels on letters or parcels
Confirm receipt only when the label matches
Sign the receipt check
File the signed receipt check
outputs: filed copy of signed receipt check v1

tasks.design: A job in {OPS_SYSTEM} lists labels that are missing from the stored receipt. The carrier scans the labels on letters or parcels and confirms receipt only when the label matches. A later job files the signed check in {DOCS}. A blank label is not a receipt.
tasks.previous_blocker: Receipt was confirmed from memory after the round.
tasks.enabler_now: Label identifier and receipt identifier are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: The carrier still scans each item.
tasks.human_edge: The carrier decides a mismatch is not a receipt.
tasks.altitude: The carrier spends the week scanning, not on listing gaps.

reach.task: Accept only the receipt the carrier signed

evidence.claim: The executive digest says label-manifest-order matching is plain code.
Walking, driving, sorting by hand, and handing mail to a person stay with the carrier. A stored list does not do that work.

assumptions: Label identifier and receipt identifier are stored on the receipt record. The receipt record produces them. A receipt is confirmed only when the scanned label matches the stored receipt. A blank label is not a receipt. A mismatch stops with the carrier.
Native configuration of the receipt record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the carrier signed is filed or sent.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining count is still the carrier scanning labels on letters or parcels.

incremental.description: Refresh label identifier and receipt identifier when the receipt layout changes, and drop a check the carrier has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many labels are blank. The high end assumes label identifier and receipt identifier are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List registered, certified, and insured items
Obtain signed receipts for that mail
Collect associated charges and complete paperwork
Sign the charge note
File the signed charge note
outputs: filed copy of signed charge note v1

tasks.design: A job in {OPS_SYSTEM} lists registered, certified, and insured items. The carrier obtains the signed receipts, collects the associated charges, and completes the paperwork. A later job files the signed note in {DOCS}. It does not collect the money.
tasks.previous_blocker: Charges were added up at the end of the round.
tasks.enabler_now: Item identifier, service type, and charge amount are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: The signature and the cash stay with the carrier.
tasks.human_edge: The carrier decides the paperwork is complete.
tasks.altitude: The carrier spends the week collecting signatures, not on listing items.

reach.task: Sign only the receipt the carrier brings

evidence.claim: Walking, driving, sorting by hand, and handing mail to a person stay with the carrier. A stored list does not do that work.

assumptions: Item identifier, service type, and charge amount are stored on the item record. The item record produces them. A blank charge stays blank and is not collected as zero. A blank service type is not treated as registered.
Native configuration of the item record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the carrier signed is filed or sent.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining count is still the carrier obtaining signed receipts for that mail.

incremental.description: Refresh item identifier, service type, and charge amount when the item layout changes, and drop a note the carrier has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many charge amounts are blank. The high end assumes item identifier, service type, and charge amount are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Bring collected mail back to the office.

steps.what: List homes, businesses, and public mailboxes
Carry mail from homes, businesses, and public mailboxes
Return to the post office with that mail
Sign the return note
File the signed return note
outputs: filed copy of signed return note v1

tasks.design: A job in {OPS_SYSTEM} lists homes, businesses, and public mailboxes. The carrier carries the collected mail and returns to the post office. A later job files the signed note in {DOCS}. The walk is unchanged.
tasks.previous_blocker: The return was remembered rather than listed.
tasks.enabler_now: Stop identifier and stop type are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: Carrying the mail stays with the carrier.
tasks.human_edge: The carrier decides the bag is complete.
tasks.altitude: The carrier spends the week on the return, not on listing stops.

reach.task: Accept only the bag the carrier signed in

evidence.claim: Walking, driving, sorting by hand, and handing mail to a person stay with the carrier. A stored list does not do that work.

assumptions: Stop identifier and stop type are stored on the stop record. The stop record produces them. A blank stop type is not a mailbox. The list does not carry the mail.
Native configuration of the stop record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the carrier signed is filed or sent.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining count is still the carrier carrying mail from homes, businesses, and public mailboxes.

incremental.description: Refresh stop identifier and stop type when the stop layout changes, and drop a note the carrier has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many stop types are blank. The high end assumes stop identifier and stop type are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List the stored delivery sequence
Sort mail for delivery by hand
Arrange that mail into the delivery sequence
Sign the sort note
File the signed sort note
outputs: filed copy of signed sort note v1

tasks.design: A job in {OPS_SYSTEM} lists the stored delivery sequence. The carrier still sorts the mail by hand and arranges it into that sequence. A later job files the signed note in {DOCS}. The list does not sort the mail.
tasks.previous_blocker: Sequence was kept on a handwritten strip.
tasks.enabler_now: Stop order and address identifier are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: Sorting by hand stays with the carrier.
tasks.human_edge: The carrier decides a piece is out of order.
tasks.altitude: The carrier spends the week sorting, not on listing the sequence.

reach.task: Accept only the sort the carrier signed

evidence.claim: Walking, driving, sorting by hand, and handing mail to a person stay with the carrier. A stored list does not do that work.

assumptions: Stop order and address identifier are stored on the sequence record. The sequence record produces them. A blank stop order is not a place in the sequence. The carrier still sorts every piece.
Native configuration of the sequence record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the carrier signed is filed or sent.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining count is still the carrier sorting mail for delivery by hand.

incremental.description: Refresh stop order and address identifier when the sequence layout changes, and drop a note the carrier has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many stop orders are blank. The high end assumes stop order and address identifier are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

role.altitude: The carrier spends the week on the route, with the mail, and on the signed note. A stored list and filing that signature can move. The carrier still walks, sorts, collects, and signs.
reach: A patron receives only the mail the carrier delivered.
A publisher receives only the form the carrier signed.
skills_to_grow: Reject a redirect the carrier has not signed.
Reject a receipt when the label does not match.
Reject a charge that treats a blank amount as zero.
role.ambitious_version: A signed hold or address change can be filed the same day, and the carrier still walks the route.
